Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 20s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a triangle top of two small triangle cups of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey tied behind her neck and back with thin navy school-ribbon strings and joined at the center by a short closed zipper, with a small gold crest bead between the cups, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro pleated skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing on the palm front-facing with her weight on one leg, both arms relaxed at her sides, chin lifted, looking straight at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: an enormous real human hand reaches in from the lower edge of the frame with its palm open and facing up like a wide soft platform, the palm lines, fine skin creases and fingerprints in sharp macro detail, a natural sheen on the skin and glossy manicured fingernails as large as shields at the fingertips, the thumb and slightly curled fingers rising around her like soft hills; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing on the middle of the giant palm, resting in a real place: a wide red-carpeted grand staircase with standard-height steps, a waist-high brass handrail and warm daylight from tall windows, lit by natural light with soft shadows, shown softly blurred in the far background with a shallow depth of field. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous hand, palm lines and fingernails around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
